TABLE NAME / DICTIONARY REFERENCE MISMATCH. The IRW dictionary cites Kim et al. 2021, doi:10.7910/DVN/RVJIMX ('Improving Reading Comprehension, Science Domain Knowledge, and Reading Engagement through a First-Grade Content Literacy Intervention', N=674 first graders). The processing script actually reads g1g2_analyticfile_public.dta, which is deposited under doi:10.7910/DVN/HQEMN6 (Kim, Relyea, Burkhauser, Scherer & Rich 2021, Educ Psychol Rev 33:1935-1964, the conceptual replication with N=5,494 FIRST- AND SECOND-grade students). The live table has ~4,830-5,030 respondents per item, consistent with the replication, not with the 674-student first-grade trial, and it contains social-studies vocabulary items that the first-grade trial did not administer. The '_g1' suffix and the dictionary URL/Reference should be corrected: the data are grades 1 AND 2 pooled.

96 of 116 items (codes 21-116, the science and social-studies vocabulary knowledge depth assessments) ship blank item_text. Their variable labels in the deposit are generic and name no target word; the deposit's README and .do files require a Dataverse guestbook acceptance, and the source paper is paywalled with no open appendix. The sibling first-grade trial (ERIC ED662409) prints a 12-word science version of the same task ('Circle all of the words that go with the word potential.' etc.), but it is a different study and its target words were not assumed to carry over.

The 20 MMRP option sets are shipped reversed against the printed form for items 1,4,5,7,8,10,15,17,18,20, because the deposited analytic file stores a uniform scale direction. Evidence in verify_content_literacy_intervention_g1.R: 0 of 190 pairwise correlations negative, and the three content-twin pairs (2,20), (7,19), (11,15) -- printed in opposite directions -- have total-variation distances of 0.013/0.014/0.011 as shipped versus 0.856/0.521/0.548 mirrored.

The live table is the ICAR-60 (International Cognitive Ability Resource, 60-item form) as administered by the SAPA Project: 60 items, resp in {0,1} (scored correct/incorrect, not the raw multiple-choice alternative), 1,199,896 rows. The live item set decomposes exactly as the published ICAR-60 does -- 16 VR (verbal reasoning), 9 LN (letter and number series), 11 MR (matrix reasoning), 24 R3D (three-dimensional rotation) -- and data/icar_sapa.R takes the codes verbatim from ItemLists$ICAR60 in sapaICARData18aug2010thru20may2013.rdata (`for (i in 1:ncol(x)) L[[i]]<-data.frame(id=id,item=names(x)[i],...)`), so the IRW code IS the source column name (core model s3 pattern 1) and there is no mapping step to get wrong. The block is on the WORDS, not the mapping. Two independent reasons, one per item family: (1) VR and LN (25 items) have text stems, but the ICAR item pool is not published. Condon & Revelle's own data paper for this exact dataset (Journal of Open Psychology Data, 10.5334/jopd.25) reproduces no item wording and says only 'More information about all of the ICAR measures, including the item content, can be found at the ICAR website (icar-project.com)'; icar-project.org states 'You will need to register first by emailing us via the contact information given at ICAR-project.com', and https://icar-project.org/types/VR/VRitems.php 302s to /secure.php. The public /types/VR/VRstats.html page lists exactly the 16 VR codes this table holds (VR.04, VR.09, VR.11, VR.13, VR.14, VR.16, VR.17, VR.18, VR.19, VR.23, VR.26, VR.31, VR.32, VR.36, VR.39, VR.42) but prints statistics only, no stems. Obtaining the wording needs author contact -- something IRW does not have -- and the project gates the pool deliberately to limit item exposure. (2) MR and R3D (35 items) are figural: matrix-reasoning grids and 3D block-rotation figures. They have no text stem at all, only a per-type prompt, so even an unrestricted source would give no per-item wording. Sources checked and rejected: psychTools Rd_db (iqitems.Rd, ability.Rd) documents only 16 SAPA ability items under a DIFFERENT naming scheme (reason.4/letter.7/matrix.45/rotate.3) and supplies only type-level descriptions ('In the following alphanumeric series, what letter comes next?', 'A matrix reasoning task') -- no per-item content, no VR./LN./MR./R3D. codes; the JOPD data paper; icar-project.org and icar-project.com (the latter now 301s to a TU Dortmund project page); GitHub frenchja/icar (R helper functions only, no items) and Mac3581/Italian-Adaptation-and-Validation-of-the-ICAR-16-Sample-Test (an ICAR-16 Italian adaptation; its ICAR16_Codebook_English.xlsx contains no ICAR item codes and no stems -- 225 shared strings, zero matches for VR./LN./MR./R3D./'comes next'). Shipping the type-level prompt as item_text for all 60 rows was considered and rejected under the irw#1770 rule: the same generic sentence repeated nine times carries no item's referent. Nothing was invented and no partial CSV was staged. Retry route if ever wanted: email the ICAR project to register for the item pool; even then MR and R3D would remain stems-as-images.

Clean pass with one caveat worth a human eye. resp is a derived per-item score (right minus wrong selections, -5..5), not a response option, so option_text is blank for all 313 rows and correct_response holds the five correct alternatives as TEXT rather than as resp values -- an analyst expecting correct_response to be a resp level will not find one. The five decoy alternatives per question were not shipped (no schema field carries them) and remain in the source codebook. The administered instructions state a -1.25 penalty per wrong answer while the stored score penalises exactly 1 per wrong answer, verified against the raw data for all 32 items; that discrepancy is carried as a public_note.

BLOCKED -- no item text exists to extract, and the item code is additionally ambiguous. (1) NO TEXT AT ANY LEVEL: the Eedi NeurIPS 2020 Education Challenge publishes no question wording. Challenge guide arXiv:2007.12061 sec 2.2: 'In Tasks 3 and 4 ... we will also provide the image presented to the student for each question ... The question images have been shared solely for the purpose of this competition and must not be used for any other purpose. The question images must not be printed or shared with anyone outside of the competition. The question wording is contained in the images but will not be made available as text.' So text is released for zero questions; images exist only for the 948 task-3/4 questions (3.4% of the table's 27,613 items) and their reuse/redistribution is expressly barred by the source, which is also why OCR is not a route here. The released metadata files (question_metadata, subject_metadata) carry only SubjectId topic tags, no stems and no options. (2) ITEM CODE COLLISION (a data defect, not just an extraction obstacle): data/neurlps_2020.R rbinds the task-1/2 files with the task-3/4 files and sets item = question_id + 1, but the guide (p.8) states the two datasets are anonymized SEPARATELY and 'IMPORTANT: Question, User and Answer IDs should not be linked between the data for these pairs of tasks!'. Task 1/2 has 27,613 questions and task 3/4 a disjoint 948; the live table has exactly 27,613 items contiguous 1..27613 rather than 28,561, and items 1-948 carry a median 2,515 responses against 396 for items 949-27613 (6.35x), ~1.89M excess rows. Item codes 1-948 therefore each pool answers to two different questions, so even a hypothetical text source could not be mapped to them. (3) RESP CONFLATION: the same script renames AnswerValue (a 1-4 option choice) to IsCorrect for test_public/private_answers_task_2 before the rbind, so resp mixes binary correctness with option identity. Live resp set is 0,1,2,3,4 and 22,468 of 27,613 items show all five levels; resp=1 means 'correct' for some rows and 'chose option 1' for others. option_text is unmappable independently of the item problem. The table was NOT fetched (24,076,951 rows); every figure above comes from irw_table_sets() server-side aggregates.

WHAT IS RECOVERABLE, for whoever revisits this: (a) the item code is decoded - item = 1-based rank of QuestionId in ascending numeric order, reproducing per-item n for all 5730 items (see verify_neurips_2022.R); (b) topic_pathway_metadata.csv gives ConstructId + SubjectName for 5,275 of the 5,730 questions (1,041 distinct constructs, e.g. 'Counting', 'Place Value'), which is a topic label, not the item's own referent, so it was deliberately NOT shipped as item_text; (c) CorrectAnswer (1-4) is present and internally consistent for all 5,730 questions (4 have a conflicting value), so correct_response is fillable the day the question images become available.

PASS with caveats. Item text written for all 75 items; validate_items.R passes on both item and resp sets, mapping VERIFIED by re-running the derivation (verify_vocabulary_iq.R). Three things a human should know. (1) Step 3b mismatch: the table is not purely a vocabulary measure. Items 1-45 are the openpsychometrics Vocabulary IQ Test's 45 five-word synonym questions; items 46-75 are the optional post-test personality survey (codebook S1-S30, e.g. 'I prefer to be barefoot.'), a different instrument bundled into the same table by data/vocabulary_iq.R. The dictionary Description and table name should say so.

(2) Response-data defect, not an item-text gap: data/vocabulary_iq.R scores every column against the vocabulary answer key, so the supplemental items' 1-5 agreement responses (361,632 non-missing cells) are all collapsed to resp=0. Items 46-75 therefore have a single, degenerate resp level in the live table and are unusable as responses. Their rows ship with blank option_text rather than an invented label, which is what audit_batch.R's single WARN ('30 of 75 items have NO option_text rows while others do', 25% blank option_text) is reporting - expected, not a fix. Worth a data-fix issue against the processing script.

(3) For the vocabulary items resp=0 means 'not the correct pair' and absorbs the 0.87% of cells where the respondent did not answer (raw value 0), while the 13.26% of cells where they selected 'don't know' (raw -1) are missing. correct_response holds the two correct words decoded from the codebook's answer bitmask, since the shipped resp is already scored 0/1 and the words are otherwise unrecoverable from the table.
